lines.zh: 我贴着地跑，肚子拖着像口袋。
lines.en: I run low, my belly dragging like a sack.

lines.zh: 充了气我就飘，得用爪子抓地。
lines.en: Inflated, I drift, so my claws grip the ground.

lines.zh: 我一路小跑，尾巴扫起灰。
lines.en: I trot along and my tail sweeps up dust.

lines.zh: 别踩我的尾巴，它还在放气。
lines.en: Do not step on my tail; it is still venting air.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方有股蜘蛛眼味。
lines.en: Wherever I pass, a spider eye smell lingers.

lines.zh: 我鼓着身子，挤过两个箱子之间。
lines.en: Swelled up, I squeeze between two chests.

lines.zh: 我跑得歪，因为一半身子比另一半胀。
lines.en: I run crooked because one side is fuller than the other.

lines.zh: 我蹦一下，肚子里的气咕噜响。
lines.en: I hop once and the air in my belly gurgles.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的脚转，看你带没带蛋糕。
lines.en: I circle your feet, checking whether you brought cake.

lines.zh: 我溜得很快，尤其在你回头前。
lines.en: I slip away fast, especially before you turn around.

lines.zh: 每走一步，皮就松一下再绷紧。
lines.en: Each step loosens my hide, then pulls it taut again.

lines.zh: 我踮脚走，怕把肚子蹭破。
lines.en: I walk on tiptoe, afraid of scraping my belly open.

lines.zh: 我在墙上蹭，背上的气鼓成球。
lines.en: I rub against the wall and the air on my back bulges.

lines.zh: 我闻着味走，毒纸杯蛋糕不会跑。
lines.en: I follow the smell; a poison cupcake will not run off.

lines.zh: 我把气收一半，才走得稳当。
lines.en: I let out half my air so I can walk steady.

lines.zh: 我踩着箱子的边，一路小跑过去。
lines.en: I trot along the edge of the crates.

lines.zh: 我坐直了，肚子一鼓一瘪地喘。
lines.en: I sit up, my belly swelling and sinking with breath.

lines.zh: 没下命令，我就缩到巴掌大。
lines.en: With no order given, I shrink to a palm's size.

lines.zh: 我舔爪子，顺便抹一抹鼻子。
lines.en: I lick my paws and wipe my nose with them.

lines.zh: 气憋着难受，我隔会儿放一点。
lines.en: Held air is uncomfortable, so I release a little now and then.

lines.zh: 我蹲着发呆，尾巴一卷一松。
lines.en: I squat and stare, tail curling and uncurling.

lines.zh: 我在等你说，治还是打。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to say heal or fight.

lines.zh: 身上痒，我打了个滚，气跑掉一半。
lines.en: I itch, roll over, and half my air escapes.

lines.zh: 我听见瓦罐响，以为是蛋糕盒。
lines.en: A jar clinks and I think it is the cake box.

lines.zh: 我把自己吹圆，看能不能挡住洞口。
lines.en: I blow myself round to see if I can plug the burrow.

lines.zh: 没事做时，我数自己身上的褶。
lines.en: With nothing to do, I count the folds on my body.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，整个身子瘪下去。
lines.en: I sneeze and my whole body deflates.

lines.zh: 我眯着眼，气在肚子里游来游去。
lines.en: I squint as air wanders around inside my belly.

lines.zh: 我抬眼瞧你，肚子先朝你转。
lines.en: I look up at you, belly turning toward you first.

lines.zh: 你的手一抬，我就知道该鼓还是该瘪。
lines.en: One lift of your hand tells me to swell or deflate.

lines.zh: 我盯着你口袋，那里有蛋糕的响动。
lines.en: I stare at your pocket, where cake rustles.

lines.zh: 我看你时，气会不自觉地涨一点。
lines.en: Whenever I look at you, my air rises a little on its own.

lines.zh: 你眼睛发红，我还记得那只蜘蛛。
lines.en: Your eyes are red; I still remember that spider.

lines.zh: 我歪头，想看清你拿的是毒还是药。
lines.en: I tilt my head to see whether you hold poison or cure.

lines.zh: 我靠过去嗅你鞋，鼻子压得变形。
lines.en: I lean in to sniff your shoe, nose squashed flat.

lines.zh: 你叫我名字，我就把气收了收。
lines.en: When you say my name, I draw some air back in.

lines.zh: 我看你的脸色，决定用哪种毒素。
lines.en: I read your face and pick which toxin to use.

lines.zh: 我眨眨眼，皮上的褶皱跟着动。
lines.en: I blink and the folds on my hide shift.

lines.zh: 你往后退，我跟着鼓了一寸。
lines.en: You step back and I swell an inch in answer.

lines.zh: 我把脸贴到你靴边，等你发话。
lines.en: I press my face to your boot and wait for orders.

lines.zh: 你打在我鼓起的皮上，气嘶嘶地漏。
lines.en: You strike my swollen hide and air hisses out.

lines.zh: 我疼得缩成一小团，尖牙也收起来。
lines.en: I hurt and shrink small, fangs tucked away.

lines.zh: 这一下把气打散了，我走路都在晃。
lines.en: The blow scatters my air and I stagger.

lines.zh: 我咬你一口就跑，毒还没上来。
lines.en: I bite you once and run before the poison rises.

lines.zh: 皮破了，我瘪得比出生时还小。
lines.en: My hide splits and I deflate smaller than at birth.

lines.zh: 我嗷一声，肚子的气全从嘴里跑掉。
lines.en: I yelp and all my belly air escapes through my mouth.

lines.zh: 你砍到我的尾巴，我立刻转成攻击。
lines.en: You cut my tail and I switch straight to attack mode.

lines.zh: 我滚出去老远，撞上墙才停。
lines.en: I roll far and only stop at the wall.

lines.zh: 我喘不上气，得等你停手才好鼓。
lines.en: I cannot catch my breath until you stop swinging.

lines.zh: 伤口在冒泡，那是我自己带的毒。
lines.en: The wound bubbles; that is my own poison.

lines.zh: 蜘蛛眼，我认这个味道，快给我。
lines.en: Spider eye! I know that smell, so hand it over.

lines.zh: 你把眼睛递过来，我立刻服了。
lines.en: You offer the eye and I submit at once.

lines.zh: 先吃蜘蛛眼，再谈别的。
lines.en: Spider eye first; we can discuss the rest after.

lines.zh: 我嗅到毒纸杯蛋糕，气自己涨起来。
lines.en: I smell a poison cupcake and my air rises by itself.

lines.zh: 这是蜘蛛眼吗？我尾巴都直了。
lines.en: Is that a spider eye? My tail has gone stiff.

lines.zh: 我咬着你的袖口，往蛋糕那边拖。
lines.en: I bite your sleeve and drag you toward the cake.

lines.zh: 你别晃，我要看清是哪种毒素的。
lines.en: Hold still; I need to see which toxin it is.

lines.zh: 我舔了一下，气立刻充到脖子。
lines.en: I lick it once and air rushes up to my neck.

lines.zh: 蛋糕越毒，我肚子鼓得越圆。
lines.en: The more poisonous the cake, the rounder I swell.

lines.zh: 我抱着你的手，怕你收回去。
lines.en: I hug your hand, afraid you will take it back.

lines.zh: 闻到蜘蛛眼，我就忘了自己多大。
lines.en: One sniff of spider eye and I forget my own size.

lines.zh: 我一边吃一边放气，像在打拍子。
lines.en: I eat and vent air as if keeping time.

lines.zh: 你踩到我尾巴，我当场漏了气。
lines.en: You step on my tail and I leak air on the spot.

lines.zh: 我撞到你膝盖，弹开半米。
lines.en: I hit your knee and bounce back half a meter.

lines.zh: 我鼓得正满，一碰就滚出去。
lines.en: Fully inflated, one touch sends me rolling.

lines.zh: 别推我，里面的气会乱窜。
lines.en: Do not shove me; the air inside will slosh wild.

lines.zh: 我挤过你腿边，皮蹭得嘎吱响。
lines.en: I squeeze past your legs, hide creaking.

lines.zh: 你踢到我，我像个球一样跳。
lines.en: You kick me and I bounce like a ball.

lines.zh: 我撞门框，憋着没让自己炸。
lines.en: I hit the doorframe and hold myself together.

lines.zh: 被撞时我缩一圈，再慢慢鼓回。
lines.en: On impact I shrink a turn, then slowly refill.

lines.zh: 我贴着你走，把重量全压你脚上。
lines.en: I walk against you, all my weight on your foot.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我肚子凹进去又弹出来。
lines.en: One touch dents my belly, then it pops back out.

lines.zh: 我们两只鼓着气，撞在一起像球。
lines.en: We two inflate and knock together like balls.

lines.zh: 我把蜘蛛眼让给它，那算求偶了。
lines.en: I yield the spider eye to it; that counts as courting.

lines.zh: 它的皮比我紧，我给吹松一点。
lines.en: Its hide is tighter than mine, so I puff it looser.

lines.zh: 我们并排躺在洞口，气一涨一落。
lines.en: We lie side by side at the entrance, air rising and falling.

lines.zh: 我追它，它的尾巴在墙边扫。
lines.en: I chase it and its tail sweeps the wall.

lines.zh: 它也吃毒蛋糕，我们尝同一个味。
lines.en: It eats poison cake too, so we share the same taste.

lines.zh: 我们肚皮贴着，气在中间挤来挤去。
lines.en: Our bellies press together, air squeezed between them.

lines.zh: 我把最圆的那个蛋糕留给它。
lines.en: I save the roundest cupcake for it.

lines.zh: 它生气时更圆，我看着就想笑。
lines.en: It swells when angry, and I want to laugh.

lines.zh: 夜里我们靠在一起，一放气就醒。
lines.en: At night we lean together and wake at every vent.

lines.zh: 我用前爪抱起来，走三步就掉。
lines.en: I hug it with my front paws and drop it in three steps.

lines.zh: 肚子太鼓，我弯不下腰捡东西。
lines.en: My belly is too full for me to bend and pick things up.

lines.zh: 我叼着蛋糕屑，一路滴滴答答。
lines.en: I carry cake crumbs and drip them all the way.

lines.zh: 你扔的东西，我先闻再收进窝。
lines.en: Things you throw, I sniff first, then stash.

lines.zh: 我爪子上有黏的东西，抓不住。
lines.en: My paws are sticky and cannot grip.

lines.zh: 掉下来的果子，我顶着走。
lines.en: A fallen berry I push along with my head.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进腮边，气会更足。
lines.en: I stuff it by my cheek, and my air grows stronger.

lines.zh: 我要是捡了毒蛋糕，得藏好。
lines.en: If I pick up poison cake, I must hide it well.

lines.zh: 我拖着你留下的眼，一半进了肚。
lines.en: I drag the eye you left; half is already inside me.

lines.zh: 捡起来又放气，东西就飞了。
lines.en: I pick it up, vent air, and the thing flies off.

lines.zh: 我一闻见生人，气先鼓半格。
lines.en: One sniff of a stranger and my air rises half a notch.

lines.zh: 目标出现，我从治疗切到攻击。
lines.en: A target appears and I switch from healing to attack.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，把毒腺对准它。
lines.en: I crouch and aim my poison gland at it.

lines.zh: 你一声令下，我立刻朝它冲。
lines.en: One word from you and I charge straight at it.

lines.zh: 那东西比蛋糕还大，我照样上。
lines.en: That thing is bigger than a cupcake; I still go.

lines.zh: 我盯住它的脚踝，那里最好咬。
lines.en: I fix on its ankle, the easiest place to bite.

lines.zh: 气满了，我冲出去像支短箭。
lines.en: Full of air, I shoot out like a short arrow.

lines.zh: 我选了红的那口，味道够狠。
lines.en: I pick the red bite; that flavor is vicious.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我就跳到它背上。
lines.en: It turns and I leap onto its back.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绷直，告诉它别过来。
lines.en: I stiffen my tail to warn it off.

lines.zh: 我听见你的口哨，就知道打谁。
lines.en: I hear your whistle and know exactly whom to hit.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只把肚子鼓得像鼓。
lines.en: I make no sound; I only swell my belly like a drum.

lines.zh: 我横着移步，气全挤到一侧。
lines.en: I sidestep and all my air squeezes to one side.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的影子，等它先动。
lines.en: I bite at its shadow and wait for it to move.

lines.zh: 气在皮下滚，我随时能弹出去。
lines.en: Air rolls under my hide; I can spring any moment.

lines.zh: 我嘶一声，声音被肚子放大。
lines.en: I hiss and my belly amplifies the sound.

lines.zh: 它退，我就向前鼓起一节。
lines.en: It retreats, so I swell forward one segment.

lines.zh: 我把爪子抠进土里，稳住自己。
lines.en: I dig my claws into soil to steady myself.

lines.zh: 我盯它的喉咙，那里没毛挡着。
lines.en: I watch its throat, where no fur blocks the way.

lines.zh: 我再吹大一圈，它开始慌了。
lines.en: I puff out one more ring and it starts to panic.

lines.zh: 我数着它的呼吸，比我的慢。
lines.en: I count its breaths; they are slower than mine.

lines.zh: 气到顶了，再鼓我就要放了。
lines.en: My air is at the limit; one more puff and I burst.

lines.zh: 我左右晃，让它摸不准方向。
lines.en: I sway left and right so it cannot read my direction.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴举高，这是最后的警告。
lines.en: I raise my tail high; this is the final warning.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，全身的气压进它胸口。
lines.en: I leap and drive all my air into its chest.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的小腿，把毒递进去。
lines.en: I bite its calf and deliver the poison.

lines.zh: 我用肚子顶，把它撞得后退。
lines.en: I butt with my belly and knock it back.

lines.zh: 我弹起来，壳一样硬的皮砸过去。
lines.en: I spring up and slam my hide, hard as shell.

lines.zh: 这一口是毒纸杯蛋糕教我的。
lines.en: This bite is what the poison cupcake taught me.

lines.zh: 我咬完就滚开，等气重新鼓满。
lines.en: I bite, roll away, and wait to refill.

lines.zh: 我抓它的眼睛，爪子还带黏液。
lines.en: I claw at its eyes, paws still slimy.

lines.zh: 我扑空了，气撒了一地。
lines.en: I miss and my air spills everywhere.

lines.zh: 我缠住它的腿，等它倒下。
lines.en: I wrap around its leg and wait for it to fall.

lines.zh: 我撞它一下，自己先翻了个跟头。
lines.en: I ram it once and tumble head over heels myself.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里滚出来，浑身还瘪着。
lines.en: I roll out of the egg, still flat all over.

lines.zh: 第一口气我吸得很足，鼓成球。
lines.en: My first breath is huge and I swell into a ball.

lines.zh: 睁眼就有蜘蛛眼味，我安心了。
lines.en: I open my eyes to a spider eye smell and relax.

lines.zh: 我不知道谁驯我，但我认了手。
lines.en: I do not know who tamed me, but I accept the hand.

lines.zh: 我出生就会鼓气，这是天生的。
lines.en: I could puff air at birth; it is inborn.

lines.zh: 地上凉，我把气缩回肚子里。
lines.en: The ground is cold, so I pull my air back in.

lines.zh: 我歪歪站着，皮还没撑开。
lines.en: I stand lopsided, hide not yet stretched.

lines.zh: 第一次鼓圆，我把自己吓到了。
lines.en: The first time I went round, I frightened myself.

lines.zh: 洞里黑，我只能靠气味认路。
lines.en: The burrow is dark; I find my way by smell.

lines.zh: 我落地就找蛋糕，可惜只有草。
lines.en: I land looking for cake, but there is only grass.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的气烫得像开水。
lines.en: Fire heats the air inside me like boiling water.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，我弹了两下才瘪。
lines.en: Falling from a height, I bounce twice before flattening.

lines.zh: 水进嘴，我鼓得再大也浮不起来。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth; no amount of air keeps me up.

lines.zh: 炸风把我吹成一张皮，慢慢再鼓回。
lines.en: The blast flattens me to a sheet; I refill slowly.

lines.zh: 箭扎进肚子，气从孔里直往外吹。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my belly and air whistles out.

lines.zh: 魔法的冷钻进皮里，气凝住了。
lines.en: Magic cold seeps into my hide and my air congeals.

lines.zh: 饿的时候气也留不住，我瘪得发慌。
lines.en: When hungry I cannot hold air and go flat with panic.

lines.zh: 雷把我打得雪亮，气一下烧空了。
lines.en: Lightning lights me white and burns my air away.

lines.zh: 往下掉时，我的气被抽得干干净净。
lines.en: As I fall, the void draws every bit of air out.
